## Load Data

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
cf_microbiome_metadata <- read.csv("./rawData/16S_rRNA_gene_amplicon_studies/16S_CF_microbiome.csv")
cf_isolates <- read_csv("./rawData/isolate_identification/isolate_identification.csv")
bioassay_data <- read_csv("./rawData/cross-streak/cross-streak_inhibition_data.csv")

cf_pathogens <- c("Pseudomonas", "Staphylococcus", "Burkholderia",
                  "Stenotrophomonas", "Achromobacter", "Haemophilus",
                  "Escherichia")

files <- list.files("derivedData/mothur_output", pattern = "\\.tax\\.summary$", full.names = TRUE)

lcms_dir  <- file.path("rawData", "lcms", "overall")
lcms_diff <- read_excel(file.path(lcms_dir, "XCMS-diffreport-MultiClass.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
lcms_meta <- read_excel(file.path("rawData", "lcms", "pseudomonas_isolate_metadata.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
names(lcms_meta)[names(lcms_meta) == "Inhibition_Z-Score"] <- "inhibition_z"
if (!"NB1386" %in% lcms_meta$isolate)                       # NB1386 absent from the sheet
  lcms_meta <- bind_rows(lcms_meta, data.frame(isolate = "NB1386", host = "HID08", inhibition_z = -0.86))
lcms_meta$inhibition <- ifelse(lcms_meta$inhibition_z >= 0, "Yes", "No")

# --- LC-MS/MS total ion chromatograms (cloud plot) ---
```

## 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing processing

```{r CF_microbiota_processing, include=FALSE}
parse_tax_summary <- function(filepath) {
  read_tsv(filepath, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(taxlevel = as.integer(taxlevel), reads = as.integer(total)) %>%
    filter(taxlevel == 6, !str_detect(taxon, "unclassified")) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, reads) %>%
    mutate(sample = sub("\\.tax\\.summary$", "", basename(filepath)))
}

get_total_reads <- function(filepath) {
  read_tsv(filepath, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE, n_max = 2) %>%
    filter(as.integer(taxlevel) == 0) %>%
    transmute(sample = sub("\\.tax\\.summary$", "", basename(filepath)),
              total_reads = as.integer(total))
}

keep_samples <- map_dfr(files, get_total_reads) %>%
  filter(total_reads >= 1000) %>%
  pull(sample)

all_genera <- map_dfr(files, parse_tax_summary) %>%
  filter(sample %in% keep_samples)

metacommunity <- all_genera %>%
  group_by(genus = taxon) %>%
  summarize(total_reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rel_abund = round(total_reads / sum(total_reads)*100),2) %>%
  arrange(desc(rel_abund)) %>%
  mutate(genus = if_else(row_number() <= 20, genus, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarize(rel_abund = sum(rel_abund), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(rel_abund))

genus_matrix <- all_genera %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample, names_from = taxon,
              values_from = reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  as.matrix()

row_totals <- rowSums(genus_matrix)
row_totals[row_totals == 0] <- NA
genus_matrix[sweep(genus_matrix, 1, row_totals, FUN = "/") < 0.001] <- 0

genus_matrix <- genus_matrix[,
  names(which(colSums(genus_matrix > 0) >= ceiling(0.01 * nrow(genus_matrix))))
]

table1_genera <- c("Streptococcus", "Pseudomonas", "Staphylococcus", "Prevotella",
                   "Haemophilus", "Veillonella", "Rothia", "Stenotrophomonas",
                   "Neisseria", "Granulicatella", "Achromobacter", "Gemella",
                   "Porphyromonas", "Burkholderia", "Fusobacterium", "Actinomyces",
                   "Schaalia", "Alloprevotella", "Escherichia")

overall_rel_abund <- colSums(genus_matrix) / sum(genus_matrix) * 100
prevalence_pct    <- colSums(genus_matrix > 0) / nrow(genus_matrix) * 100

stopifnot(all(table1_genera %in% colnames(genus_matrix)))
keep_genera <- table1_genera

genus_matrix_filt <- genus_matrix[, keep_genera, drop = FALSE]

# report the Table 1 quantities for the genera used
print(data.frame(genus = keep_genera,
                 overall_rel_abund = round(overall_rel_abund[keep_genera], 1),
                 prevalence_pct    = round(prevalence_pct[keep_genera], 1),
                 row.names = NULL))

write.csv(genus_matrix_filt, "derivedData/genus_matrix_filt.csv")
```

```{r metacommunity_table, include=FALSE}
n_samples   <- length(keep_samples)
grand_total <- sum(all_genera$reads)

per_sample_ra <- all_genera %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(sample_total = sum(reads)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ra = reads / sample_total * 100)

metacommunity_table <- per_sample_ra %>%
  group_by(genus = taxon) %>%
  summarize(
    metacommunity_ra = sum(reads) / grand_total * 100,
    n_prev_01        = sum(ra >= 0.1),
    n_prev_1         = sum(ra >= 1),
    n_dominant       = sum(ra > 50),
    mean_ra          = mean(ra[ra > 0]),
    median_ra        = median(ra[ra > 0]),
    q25_ra           = quantile(ra[ra > 0], 0.25),
    q75_ra           = quantile(ra[ra > 0], 0.75),
    mean_ra_dom      = ifelse(sum(ra > 50) == 0, NA_real_,
                              mean(ra[ra > 50])),
    median_ra_dom    = ifelse(sum(ra > 50) == 0, NA_real_,
                              median(ra[ra > 50])),
    q25_ra_dom       = ifelse(sum(ra > 50) == 0, NA_real_,
                              quantile(ra[ra > 50], 0.25)),
    q75_ra_dom       = ifelse(sum(ra > 50) == 0, NA_real_,
                              quantile(ra[ra > 50], 0.75)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(metacommunity_ra)) %>%
  filter(metacommunity_ra >= 0.5) %>%
  mutate(
    metacommunity_ra  = round(metacommunity_ra, 1),
    mean_ra           = round(mean_ra, 1),
    median_ra         = round(median_ra, 1),
    range_ra          = paste0(round(q25_ra, 1), "-", round(q75_ra, 1)),
    prev_01_pct       = round(n_prev_01 / n_samples * 100, 1),
    prev_1_pct        = round(n_prev_1  / n_samples * 100, 1),
    dominant_pct      = round(n_dominant / n_samples * 100, 1),
    conditional_dominance  = round(
      ifelse(n_prev_1 == 0, NA_real_, n_dominant / n_prev_1 * 100), 1),
    mean_ra_dom       = round(mean_ra_dom, 1),
    median_ra_dom     = round(median_ra_dom, 1),
    range_ra_dom      = ifelse(is.na(q25_ra_dom), NA_character_,
                               paste0(round(q25_ra_dom, 1), "-",
                                      round(q75_ra_dom, 1)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    genus, metacommunity_ra,
    n_prev_01, prev_01_pct,
    n_prev_1,  prev_1_pct,
    n_dominant, dominant_pct, conditional_dominance,
    mean_ra, median_ra, range_ra,
    mean_ra_dom, median_ra_dom, range_ra_dom
  )

print(metacommunity_table, n = 30)

metacommunity_csv <- metacommunity_table %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr     = paste0(median_ra, " [", range_ra, "]"),
    median_iqr_dom = ifelse(is.na(median_ra_dom), NA_character_,
                            paste0(median_ra_dom, " [", range_ra_dom, "]"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Genus                              = genus,
    `Metacommunity RA (%)`             = metacommunity_ra,
    `Mean RA (%)`                      = mean_ra,
    `Median RA % [IQR]`                = median_iqr,
    `Prevalence >=1% (%)`              = prev_1_pct,
    `Dominant (>50%) (%)`              = dominant_pct,
    `Dominant given Prev >=1% (%)`     = conditional_dominance,
    `Mean RA when Dominant (%)`        = mean_ra_dom,
    `Median RA when Dominant % [IQR]`  = median_iqr_dom
  )

write.csv(metacommunity_csv, "derivedData/table_metacommunity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Conditional dominance tests: pathogen vs oropharyngeal

```{r dominance_tests, include=FALSE}
metacommunity_genera <- metacommunity_table$genus

per_sample_ra_lab <- per_sample_ra %>%
  filter(taxon %in% metacommunity_genera) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(taxon %in% cf_pathogens, "pathogen", "oropharyngeal"))

conditional_dominance_per_genus <- per_sample_ra_lab %>%
  group_by(taxon, group) %>%
  summarize(n_prev_1   = sum(ra >= 1),
            n_dominant = sum(ra > 50),
            .groups    = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_prev_1 > 0) %>%
  mutate(conditional_dominance = n_dominant / n_prev_1 * 100)

q1_wilcox <- wilcox.test(conditional_dominance ~ group, data = conditional_dominance_per_genus,
                         exact = FALSE)
print(q1_wilcox)
conditional_dominance_per_genus %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarize(n_genera    = n(),
            median_rate = median(conditional_dominance),
            q25         = quantile(conditional_dominance, 0.25),
            q75         = quantile(conditional_dominance, 0.75)) %>%
  print()

dominant_obs <- per_sample_ra_lab %>% filter(ra > 50)

q2_wilcox <- wilcox.test(ra ~ group, data = dominant_obs, exact = FALSE)
print(q2_wilcox)
dominant_obs %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarize(n_dominant_samples = n(),
            median_ra          = median(ra),
            q25                = quantile(ra, 0.25),
            q75                = quantile(ra, 0.75)) %>%
  print()

pathogen_dominant <- dominant_obs %>%
  filter(group == "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon))

q3_kw <- kruskal.test(ra ~ taxon, data = pathogen_dominant)
print(q3_kw)
pathogen_dominant %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarize(n_dominant_samples = n(),
            median_ra          = median(ra),
            q25                = quantile(ra, 0.25),
            q75                = quantile(ra, 0.75)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_ra)) %>%
  print()
```

## NMDS

```{r nmds, include=FALSE}
rel_abund_matrix <- sweep(genus_matrix, 1, rowSums(genus_matrix), "/")
rel_abund_matrix[is.nan(rel_abund_matrix)] <- 0

dir.create("r_objects", showWarnings = FALSE)

if (file.exists("r_objects/bray_dist.rds") && file.exists("r_objects/nmds.rds")) {
  bray_dist <- readRDS("r_objects/bray_dist.rds")
  nmds      <- readRDS("r_objects/nmds.rds")
} else {
  bray_dist <- parDist(rel_abund_matrix, method = "bray")

  n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cl      <- makeCluster(n_cores)
  clusterEvalQ(cl, library(vegan))
  clusterExport(cl, "bray_dist")

  starts <- parLapply(cl, seq_len(20), function(i) monoMDS(bray_dist, k = 2, maxit = 500))
  stopCluster(cl)

  nmds <- starts[[which.min(sapply(starts, `[[`, "stress"))]]

  saveRDS(bray_dist, "r_objects/bray_dist.rds")
  saveRDS(nmds,      "r_objects/nmds.rds")
}

nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Run") %>%
  left_join(cf_microbiome_metadata, by = "Run")

nmds_stress <- nmds$stress
```

### Beta Diversity: PERMANOVA

```{r permanova, include=FALSE}
if (file.exists("r_objects/permanova_combined.rds")) {
  permanova_combined <- readRDS("r_objects/permanova_combined.rds")
} else {
  set.seed(8675309)
  N_PERM <- 9999

  bray_mat <- as.matrix(bray_dist)

  cf_microbiome_metadata$Age_bin <- cut(cf_microbiome_metadata$Age,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 2, 12, 18, 40, Inf), right = FALSE,
    labels = c("Infant", "Child", "Adolescent", "Adult", "Senior"))

  cf_microbiome_metadata$FEV1_bin <- cut(cf_microbiome_metadata$FEV1,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 30, 50, 80, Inf), right = FALSE,
    labels = c("Very Severe", "Severe", "Moderate", "Mild"))

  keep_idx <- function(meta, variable) {
    x <- meta[[variable]]
    which(!is.na(x) & !(is.character(x) & x == ""))
  }

  tech_vars       <- c("BioProject", "Region")
  bio_vars        <- c("Sex", "Age", "FEV1", "Sample_Type")
  binned_vars     <- c("Age_bin", "FEV1_bin")
  partial_vars    <- c(bio_vars, binned_vars)
  partial_st_vars <- c("Sex", "Age_bin", "FEV1_bin")

  tasks <- c(
    lapply(c(tech_vars, bio_vars, binned_vars),
           function(v) list(type = "unadj",           variable = v)),
    lapply(partial_vars,
           function(v) list(type = "partial_br",      variable = v)),
    lapply(partial_st_vars,
           function(v) list(type = "partial_brst",    variable = v)),
    list(list(type = "joint_technical",
              variable = "BioProject + Sample_Type"))
  )

  n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cl      <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, library(vegan))
  parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("cf_microbiome_metadata", "bray_mat",
                                 "keep_idx", "N_PERM"))

  results <- parallel::parLapply(cl, tasks, function(task) {
    meta <- cf_microbiome_metadata
    v    <- task$variable

    if (task$type == "unadj") {
      idx      <- keep_idx(meta, v)
      dist_sub <- as.dist(bray_mat[idx, idx])
      meta_sub <- meta[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      f <- as.formula(paste("dist_sub ~", v))
      environment(f) <- environment()
      res <- as.data.frame(adonis2(f, data = meta_sub, permutations = N_PERM))
      res <- res[!rownames(res) %in% c("Residual", "Total"), , drop = FALSE]
      return(data.frame(variable = v, n = length(idx), Df = res$Df,
                        R2 = round(res$R2, 4), F = round(res$F, 3),
                        p.value = res[["Pr(>F)"]], model = "unadjusted",
                        row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE))
    }

    if (task$type == "partial_br") {
      idx      <- keep_idx(meta, v)
      dist_sub <- as.dist(bray_mat[idx, idx])
      meta_sub <- meta[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      f <- as.formula(paste("dist_sub ~ BioProject +", v))
      environment(f) <- environment()
      res <- as.data.frame(adonis2(f, data = meta_sub,
                                   permutations = N_PERM, by = "margin"))
      res <- res[v, , drop = FALSE]
      return(data.frame(variable = v, n = length(idx), Df = res$Df,
                        R2 = round(res$R2, 4), F = round(res$F, 3),
                        p.value = res[["Pr(>F)"]],
                        model = "partial (| BioProject)",
                        row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE))
    }

    if (task$type == "partial_brst") {
      idx      <- keep_idx(meta, v)
      idx      <- idx[!is.na(meta$Sample_Type[idx]) & meta$Sample_Type[idx] != ""]
      dist_sub <- as.dist(bray_mat[idx, idx])
      meta_sub <- meta[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      f <- as.formula(paste("dist_sub ~ BioProject + Sample_Type +", v))
      environment(f) <- environment()
      res <- as.data.frame(adonis2(f, data = meta_sub,
                                   permutations = N_PERM, by = "margin"))
      res <- res[v, , drop = FALSE]
      return(data.frame(variable = v, n = length(idx), Df = res$Df,
                        R2 = round(res$R2, 4), F = round(res$F, 3),
                        p.value = res[["Pr(>F)"]],
                        model = "partial (| BioProject + Sample_Type)",
                        row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE))
    }

    if (task$type == "joint_technical") {
      idx      <- which(!is.na(meta$Sample_Type) & meta$Sample_Type != "")
      dist_sub <- as.dist(bray_mat[idx, idx])
      meta_sub <- meta[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      res <- as.data.frame(adonis2(
        dist_sub ~ BioProject + Sample_Type,
        data = meta_sub, permutations = N_PERM))
      res <- res["Model", , drop = FALSE]
      return(data.frame(variable = v, n = length(idx), Df = res$Df,
                        R2 = round(res$R2, 4), F = round(res$F, 3),
                        p.value = res[["Pr(>F)"]], model = "joint technical",
                        row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE))
    }
  })

  parallel::stopCluster(cl)

  permanova_combined       <- do.call(rbind, results)
  permanova_combined$p.adj <- p.adjust(permanova_combined$p.value, method = "BH")

  saveRDS(permanova_combined, "r_objects/permanova_combined.rds")
}

print(permanova_combined, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

technical_joint_R2 <- permanova_combined$R2[permanova_combined$model == "joint technical"]

if (file.exists("r_objects/permanova_subsampling_summary.rds")) {
  permanova_subsampling_summary <- readRDS("r_objects/permanova_subsampling_summary.rds")
} else {
  set.seed(8675309)
  N_PERM_SUB <- 999
  N_REPS     <- 1000
  SUB_N      <- 100
  bray_mat <- as.matrix(bray_dist)

  if (!"Age_bin" %in% colnames(cf_microbiome_metadata)) {
    cf_microbiome_metadata$Age_bin <- cut(cf_microbiome_metadata$Age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 2, 12, 18, 40, Inf), right = FALSE,
      labels = c("Infant", "Child", "Adolescent", "Adult", "Senior"))
  }
  if (!"FEV1_bin" %in% colnames(cf_microbiome_metadata)) {
    cf_microbiome_metadata$FEV1_bin <- cut(cf_microbiome_metadata$FEV1,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 30, 50, 80, Inf), right = FALSE,
      labels = c("Very Severe", "Severe", "Moderate", "Mild"))
  }

  keep_idx_fn <- function(meta, variable) {
    x <- meta[[variable]]
    which(!is.na(x) & !(is.character(x) & x == ""))
  }

  sub_vars <- c("Sex", "Age_bin", "FEV1_bin")
  sub_tasks <- expand.grid(variable = sub_vars, rep = seq_len(N_REPS),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    apply(1, function(row) list(variable = row[["variable"]],
                                rep = as.integer(row[["rep"]])))

  n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, library(vegan))
  parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("cf_microbiome_metadata", "bray_mat",
                                "keep_idx_fn", "N_PERM_SUB", "SUB_N"),
                          envir = environment())

  sub_results <- parallel::parLapply(cl, sub_tasks, function(task) {
    meta <- cf_microbiome_metadata
    v    <- task$variable
    idx_full <- keep_idx_fn(meta, v)
    if (length(idx_full) < SUB_N) {
      return(list(variable = v, rep = task$rep, R2 = NA, pval = NA))
    }
    set.seed(task$rep * 1000 + SUB_N +
             as.integer(factor(v, levels = c("Sex","Age_bin","FEV1_bin"))))
    idx <- sample(idx_full, SUB_N)
    dist_sub <- as.dist(bray_mat[idx, idx])
    meta_sub <- meta[idx, ]
    f <- as.formula(paste("dist_sub ~", v))
    environment(f) <- environment()
    res <- tryCatch(adonis2(f, data = meta_sub, permutations = N_PERM_SUB),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(res)) return(list(variable = v, rep = task$rep, R2 = NA, pval = NA))
    res <- as.data.frame(res)
    list(variable = v, rep = task$rep,
         R2 = res["Model", "R2"], pval = res["Model", "Pr(>F)"])
  })
  parallel::stopCluster(cl)

  permanova_subsampling <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sub_results, function(r)
    data.frame(variable = r$variable, N = SUB_N, rep = r$rep,
               R2 = r$R2, pval = r$pval,
               sig = !is.na(r$pval) & r$pval < 0.05,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  saveRDS(permanova_subsampling, "r_objects/permanova_subsampling.rds")

  permanova_subsampling_summary <- permanova_subsampling %>%
    group_by(variable, N) %>%
    summarize(frac_sig = mean(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_R2  = mean(R2,  na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_R2    = sd(R2,   na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups  = "drop")
  saveRDS(permanova_subsampling_summary, "r_objects/permanova_subsampling_summary.rds")
}

print(as.data.frame(permanova_subsampling_summary))
```

## Alpha Diversity vs FEV1

```{r alpha_diversity_fev1, include=FALSE}
parse_tax_genus <- function(filepath) {
  read_tsv(filepath, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(taxlevel = as.integer(taxlevel), reads = as.integer(total)) %>%
    filter(taxlevel == 6, !str_detect(taxon, "unclassified")) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, reads) %>%
    mutate(sample = sub("\\.tax\\.summary$", "", basename(filepath)))
}

sample_totals <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  read_tsv(f, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE, n_max = 2) %>%
    filter(as.integer(taxlevel) == 0) %>%
    transmute(sample = sub("\\.tax\\.summary$", "", basename(f)),
              total_reads = as.integer(total))
}) %>% filter(total_reads >= 1000)

good_samples <- sample_totals$sample

mat_genus <- map_dfr(files, parse_tax_genus) %>%
  filter(sample %in% good_samples) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample, names_from = taxon,
              values_from = reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  as.matrix()

alpha_df <- data.frame(
  sample  = rownames(mat_genus),
  shannon = vegan::diversity(mat_genus, index = "shannon"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

alpha_df <- alpha_df %>%
  left_join(cf_microbiome_metadata %>% dplyr::select(Run, FEV1, Age, BioProject, Sample_Type, Region),
            by = c("sample" = "Run")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEV1), FEV1 != "") %>%
  mutate(FEV1 = as.numeric(FEV1),
         Age  = as.numeric(Age))

alpha_df <- alpha_df %>%
  mutate(FEV1_bin = cut(FEV1,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 30, 50, 80, Inf), right = FALSE,
    labels = c("Very Severe", "Severe", "Moderate", "Mild")))

# Adjust Shannon for Age + BioProject + Sample_Type + Region (residuals + grand mean)
complete <- !is.na(alpha_df$Age) & !is.na(alpha_df$BioProject) &
            !is.na(alpha_df$Sample_Type) & alpha_df$Sample_Type != "" &
            !is.na(alpha_df$Region) & alpha_df$Region != ""
alpha_df$shannon_adj <- NA_real_
fit_s <- lm(shannon ~ Age + BioProject + Sample_Type + Region, data = alpha_df[complete, ])
alpha_df$shannon_adj[complete] <- residuals(fit_s) + mean(alpha_df$shannon[complete])

alpha_adj <- alpha_df %>% filter(!is.na(shannon_adj))

kw_result <- kruskal.test(shannon_adj ~ FEV1_bin, data = alpha_adj)
print(kw_result)

pw_result <- pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_adj$shannon_adj, alpha_adj$FEV1_bin,
                                   p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)
print(pw_result$p.value)
```

## Berger-Parker Dominance

```{r berger_parker_prep, include=FALSE}
pathogen_cols   <- intersect(cf_pathogens, colnames(mat_genus))
pathogen_reads  <- rowSums(mat_genus[, pathogen_cols, drop = FALSE])
bp_dom_vec      <- apply(mat_genus, 1, max) / rowSums(mat_genus)
pathogen_frac   <- pathogen_reads / rowSums(mat_genus)
dominant_genus  <- colnames(mat_genus)[max.col(mat_genus, ties.method = "first")]

bp_df <- data.frame(
  sample           = rownames(mat_genus),
  bp_dom           = bp_dom_vec,
  pathogen_frac    = pathogen_frac,
  dominant_genus   = dominant_genus,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    dominant_pathogen = if_else(dominant_genus %in% cf_pathogens,
                                dominant_genus, "Other")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cf_microbiome_metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(Run, FEV1, Age, BioProject, Sample_Type, Region),
    by = c("sample" = "Run")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEV1), FEV1 != "") %>%
  mutate(
    FEV1     = as.numeric(FEV1),
    Age      = as.numeric(Age),
    FEV1_bin = cut(FEV1,
                   breaks = c(-Inf, 30, 50, 80, Inf), right = FALSE,
                   labels = c("Very Severe", "Severe", "Moderate", "Mild"))
  )

bp_complete <- !is.na(bp_df$Age) &
               !is.na(bp_df$BioProject) &
               !is.na(bp_df$Sample_Type) & bp_df$Sample_Type != "" &
               !is.na(bp_df$Region)      & bp_df$Region      != ""

fit_bp <- lm(bp_dom ~ Age + BioProject + Sample_Type + Region,
             data = bp_df[bp_complete, ])
bp_df$bp_adj <- NA_real_
bp_df$bp_adj[bp_complete] <- residuals(fit_bp) + mean(bp_df$bp_dom[bp_complete])

fit_fev1 <- lm(FEV1 ~ Age + BioProject + Sample_Type + Region,
               data = bp_df[bp_complete, ])
bp_df$FEV1_adj <- NA_real_
bp_df$FEV1_adj[bp_complete] <- residuals(fit_fev1) + mean(bp_df$FEV1[bp_complete])

bp_adj_df <- bp_df %>% filter(!is.na(bp_adj))

n_boot_bp <- 100
n_bp      <- nrow(bp_adj_df)
boot_lines_bp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_boot_bp), function(b) {
  bi  <- sample(seq_len(n_bp), replace = TRUE)
  fit <- lm(bp_adj_df$FEV1_adj[bi] ~ bp_adj_df$bp_dom[bi])
  data.frame(x    = range(bp_adj_df$bp_dom),
             y    = coef(fit)[1] + coef(fit)[2] * range(bp_adj_df$bp_dom),
             boot = b)
}))

bp_full_lm  <- lm(FEV1 ~ bp_dom + Age + BioProject + Sample_Type + Region,
                  data = bp_df[bp_complete, ])
bp_full_s   <- summary(bp_full_lm)
bp_coef_row <- bp_full_s$coefficients["bp_dom", ]
bp_p_fmt    <- format(bp_coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"], digits = 2, scientific = TRUE)
bp_stat_label <- paste0("italic(P)[adj] == ", bp_p_fmt)

print(bp_full_s$coefficients["bp_dom", ])
sprintf("Adj. R^2 = %.3f", bp_full_s$adj.r.squared)
```

## Interaction Analyses

```{r pairwise_cooccurrence, include=FALSE}
genera   <- colnames(genus_matrix_filt)
n_genera <- length(genera)

log_abund <- log10(genus_matrix_filt + 1)

pairs   <- combn(genera, 2)
n_pairs <- ncol(pairs)
bonf_thresh <- 0.05 / n_pairs

pw_res <- vector("list", n_pairs)
for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
  g1 <- pairs[1, k]; g2 <- pairs[2, k]
  fit <- lm(log_abund[, g1] ~ log_abund[, g2])
  s   <- summary(fit)
  pw_res[[k]] <- data.frame(genus1 = g1, genus2 = g2,
                             bx = coef(fit)[2], pval = s$coefficients[2, 4],
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
pairwise_results <- do.call(rbind, pw_res)
pairwise_results$significant <- pairwise_results$pval < bonf_thresh

edge_list <- pairwise_results %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(bx > 0, "positive", "negative"))

sig_pairs <- pairwise_results %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  mutate(
    g1_path   = genus1 %in% cf_pathogens,
    g2_path   = genus2 %in% cf_pathogens,
    pair_type = case_when(
      g1_path & g2_path   ~ "pathogen-pathogen",
      g1_path | g2_path   ~ "pathogen-anaerobe",
      TRUE                ~ "anaerobe-anaerobe"
    ),
    direction = ifelse(bx > 0, "positive", "negative")
  )

pair_dir_summary <- sig_pairs %>%
  count(pair_type, direction) %>%
  group_by(pair_type) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / total) %>%
  ungroup()

print(as.data.frame(pair_dir_summary))
print(sig_pairs %>% count(pair_type))
```

```{r pathogenic_interaction_model, include=FALSE}
fev1_meta <- cf_microbiome_metadata %>%
  filter(Run %in% rownames(genus_matrix_filt), !is.na(FEV1), FEV1 != "")
fev1_runs <- fev1_meta$Run
fev1_vals <- as.numeric(fev1_meta$FEV1)
log_fev1  <- log_abund[fev1_runs, , drop = FALSE]

int_res <- vector("list", n_pairs)
for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
  g1 <- pairs[1, k]; g2 <- pairs[2, k]
  pn <- log_fev1[, g1]; px <- log_fev1[, g2]
  fit <- lm(fev1_vals ~ pn + px + pn:px)
  s   <- summary(fit)
  coefs <- s$coefficients
  bi   <- if ("pn:px" %in% rownames(coefs)) coefs["pn:px", "Estimate"] else NA
  pval <- if ("pn:px" %in% rownames(coefs)) coefs["pn:px", "Pr(>|t|)"] else NA
  int_res[[k]] <- data.frame(genus1 = g1, genus2 = g2, bi = bi,
                              pval_interaction = pval, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
interaction_df <- do.call(rbind, int_res) %>% filter(!is.na(bi))
interaction_df$fdr_interaction <- p.adjust(interaction_df$pval_interaction, method = "BH")
interaction_df$sig_interaction <- interaction_df$fdr_interaction < 0.05

covar_pairs <- pairwise_results[pairwise_results$significant, c("genus1", "genus2")]
sig_taxa    <- unique(c(covar_pairs$genus1, covar_pairs$genus2))

PRES_THRESH   <- 1     # a genus counts as present at >=1% within-sample relative abundance
pres_ra       <- 100 * genus_matrix_filt / rowSums(genus_matrix_filt)
pres_ra[!is.finite(pres_ra)] <- 0
pres_matrix   <- pres_ra[fev1_runs, , drop = FALSE] >= PRES_THRESH
n_interacting <- rowSums(pres_matrix[, covar_pairs$genus1, drop = FALSE] &
                         pres_matrix[, covar_pairs$genus2, drop = FALSE])
bioproject    <- fev1_meta$BioProject
sample_type   <- fev1_meta$Sample_Type
region        <- fev1_meta$Region

fev1_age_raw <- fev1_meta %>%
  mutate(Age_bin = case_when(
    is.na(Age)           ~ "NA",
    Age < 12             ~ "0\u201311",
    Age >= 12 & Age < 18 ~ "12\u201317",
    Age >= 18 & Age < 40 ~ "18\u201339",
    Age >= 40            ~ "40+"
  )) %>% pull(Age_bin)

age_levels_raw <- c("0\u201311", "12\u201317", "18\u201339", "40+", "NA")
age_counts     <- table(factor(fev1_age_raw, levels = age_levels_raw))
age_label_map  <- setNames(paste0(names(age_counts), " (N=", age_counts, ")"),
                           names(age_counts))
fev1_age <- age_label_map[fev1_age_raw]

fev1_age_vals <- as.numeric(fev1_meta$Age)
complete_idx  <- !is.na(fev1_age_vals) & !is.na(bioproject) &
                 !is.na(sample_type) & sample_type != "" &
                 !is.na(region) & region != ""
confound_fit  <- lm(fev1_vals[complete_idx] ~ fev1_age_vals[complete_idx] +
                    bioproject[complete_idx] + sample_type[complete_idx] +
                    region[complete_idx])
fev1_adjusted <- residuals(confound_fit) + mean(fev1_vals[complete_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
n_interacting_adj <- n_interacting[complete_idx]
fev1_age_adj      <- fev1_age[complete_idx]

n_boot_val <- 100
n_adj <- length(fev1_adjusted)
boot_lines_adj <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_boot_val), function(b) {
  bi <- sample(seq_len(n_adj), replace = TRUE)
  fit <- lm(fev1_adjusted[bi] ~ n_interacting_adj[bi])
  data.frame(x = range(n_interacting_adj),
             y = coef(fit)[1] + coef(fit)[2] * range(n_interacting_adj), boot = b)
}))

adj_full_lm <- lm(fev1_vals[complete_idx] ~ n_interacting[complete_idx] +
                     fev1_age_vals[complete_idx] + bioproject[complete_idx] +
                     sample_type[complete_idx] + region[complete_idx])
adj_full_s  <- summary(adj_full_lm)
adj_coef <- signif(adj_full_s$coefficients["n_interacting[complete_idx]", "Estimate"], 2)
adj_r2   <- signif(adj_full_s$r.squared, 2)
adj_p    <- format(adj_full_s$coefficients["n_interacting[complete_idx]", "Pr(>|t|)"],
                   digits = 2, scientific = TRUE)
adj_stat_label <- paste0("italic(P)[adj] == ", adj_p,
                         "~~R[adj]^2 == ", adj_r2,
                         "~~beta == '+'*", adj_coef, "*'%'~FEV[1]~Genus^-1")
```

```{r interaction_helpers, include=FALSE}
fit_region_pairs <- function(la) {
  res <- data.frame(genus1 = pairs[1, ], genus2 = pairs[2, ],
                    bx = NA_real_, r = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    y <- la[, pairs[1, k]]; x <- la[, pairs[2, k]]
    if (sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) next          
    fit <- lm(y ~ x)
    res$bx[k]   <- coef(fit)[2]
    res$r[k]    <- cor(x, y)
    res$pval[k] <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
  }
  res
}

ccc <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  2 * cov(x, y) / (var(x) + var(y) + (mean(x) - mean(y))^2)
}
```

```{r alpha_vs_interactions_effect, include=FALSE}
effect_df <- bp_df[bp_complete, ]
effect_df$shannon <- alpha_adj$shannon[match(effect_df$sample, alpha_adj$sample)]
effect_df$n_int   <- n_interacting[match(effect_df$sample, fev1_runs)]

  effect_df[, c("FEV1", "bp_dom", "shannon", "n_int",
                "Age", "BioProject", "Sample_Type")]), ]

effect_metrics <- c(n_int   = "Covarying associations",
                    shannon = "Diversity",
                    bp_dom  = "Dominance")

effect_std_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(effect_metrics), function(v) {
  f <- as.formula(sprintf("FEV1 ~ scale(%s) + Age + BioProject + Sample_Type", v))
  s <- summary(lm(f, data = effect_df))$coefficients[sprintf("scale(%s)", v), ]
  data.frame(metric    = effect_metrics[[v]], variable = v,
             b_std     = s[["Estimate"]], abs_b_std = abs(s[["Estimate"]]),
             t         = s[["t value"]],  p         = s[["Pr(>|t|)"]],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
effect_std_tab <- effect_std_tab[order(-effect_std_tab$abs_b_std), ]
effect_n <- nrow(effect_df)

# Collinearity: why these are fit separately rather than jointly

cor_dom_div <- effect_cor["bp_dom", "shannon"]

print(effect_std_tab, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
print(round(effect_cor, 3))
```

```{r pseudorep_setup, include=FALSE}
reps_meta <- read.csv(
  "rawData/16S_rRNA_gene_amplicon_studies/16S_CF_microbiome_with_reps_long.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
reps_meta$indiv <- paste(reps_meta$BioProject, reps_meta$Sample_ID, sep = "|")

run_indiv <- setNames(reps_meta$indiv, reps_meta$Run)
run_bp    <- setNames(reps_meta$BioProject, reps_meta$Run)
run_reads <- setNames(as.numeric(reps_meta$Bacterial_Read_Count), reps_meta$Run)

runs_per_indiv <- table(reps_meta$indiv)
class_counts   <- table(reps_meta$Sample_Class)
repeated_sampling_summary <- data.frame(
  quantity = c("Sequencing runs", "Unique individuals",
               "Runs from repeat-sampled individuals (%)",
               "Max runs per individual",
               "Class: independent", "Class: longitudinal",
               "Class: replicate", "Class: unresolved"),
  value = c(nrow(reps_meta), length(runs_per_indiv),
            round(100 * sum(runs_per_indiv[reps_meta$indiv] > 1) / nrow(reps_meta), 1),
            max(runs_per_indiv),
            as.integer(class_counts["independent"]), as.integer(class_counts["longitudinal"]),
            as.integer(class_counts["replicate"]),   as.integer(class_counts["unresolved"])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

print(repeated_sampling_summary)

pick_one_per_indiv <- function(runs) {
  runs <- runs[!is.na(run_indiv[runs])]
  runs <- runs[order(run_indiv[runs], -run_reads[runs], runs)]
  runs[!duplicated(run_indiv[runs])]
}

df2A <- data.frame(run = fev1_runs, FEV1 = fev1_vals, n_int = n_interacting,
                   Age = as.numeric(fev1_meta$Age), BioProject = fev1_meta$BioProject,
                   Sample_Type = fev1_meta$Sample_Type, Region = fev1_meta$Region,
                   indiv = run_indiv[fev1_runs], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

full_b   <- pairwise_results$bx
full_sig <- pairwise_results$significant
concord_2b <- function(b_new) {
  est <- is.finite(b_new)
  c(signs    = 100 * mean(sign(b_new[full_sig & est]) == sign(full_b[full_sig & est])),
    spearman = cor(full_b[est], b_new[est], method = "spearman"),
    ccc      = ccc(full_b[est], b_new[est]))
}
```

## Tables S2 and S3

```{r tables_S2_S3, include=FALSE}
S2_VARS <- c("Sample_Type", "Age", "Sex", "FEV1")
S2_PERM <- 999
S2_SEED <- 8675309

s2_fit <- function() {
  bm <- as.matrix(bray_dist)
  m  <- cf_microbiome_metadata[match(rownames(bm), cf_microbiome_metadata$Run), ]
  rownames(m) <- rownames(bm)
  for (v in c("Sex", "Sample_Type", "Region", "Instrument"))
    if (!is.null(m[[v]])) m[[v]][!is.na(m[[v]]) & trimws(m[[v]]) == ""] <- NA
  m$Age  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m$Age))
  m$FEV1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m$FEV1))
  cc  <- function(vs) rownames(m)[Reduce(`&`, lapply(vs, function(v) !is.na(m[[v]])))]
  one <- pick_one_per_indiv(rownames(bm))

  fit <- function(runs, rhs, keep) {
    d <- as.dist(bm[runs, runs]); dat <- m[runs, , drop = FALSE]
    f <- as.formula(paste("d ~", rhs)); environment(f) <- environment()
    set.seed(S2_SEED)
    r <- as.data.frame(adonis2(f, data = dat, permutations = S2_PERM, by = "margin"))
    data.frame(term = keep, n = length(runs), R2 = r[keep, "R2"], p = r[keep, "Pr(>F)"])
  }
  hl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(S2_VARS, function(v) {
    rhs  <- if (v == "Sample_Type") "BioProject + Sample_Type"
            else paste("BioProject + Sample_Type +", v)
    runs <- cc(unique(c("Sample_Type", v)))
    a <- fit(runs, rhs, v); b <- fit(intersect(runs, one), rhs, v)
    data.frame(term = v, n_all = a$n, R2_all = a$R2, p_all = a$p,
               n_one = b$n, R2_one = b$R2, p_one = b$p)
  }))

  ps <- do.call(rbind, unlist(lapply(S2_VARS, function(v)
    lapply(unique(m$BioProject), function(bp) {
      runs <- rownames(m)[m$BioProject == bp & !is.na(m[[v]])]
      if (length(runs) < 20 || length(unique(m[runs, v])) < 2) return(NULL)
      d <- as.dist(bm[runs, runs]); dat <- m[runs, , drop = FALSE]
      f <- as.formula(paste("d ~", v)); environment(f) <- environment()
      set.seed(S2_SEED)
      r <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(adonis2(f, data = dat, permutations = S2_PERM)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
      x <- dat[[v]]
      if (is.numeric(x)) {
        rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(as.vector(d), as.vector(stats::dist(x)),
                                    method = "spearman"))
      } else {
        m2 <- as.matrix(d); same <- outer(x, x, "=="); ut <- upper.tri(m2)
        rho <- mean(m2[ut & !same]) - mean(m2[ut & same])
      }
      data.frame(variable = v, n = length(runs), p = r[1, "Pr(>F)"],
                 direction_rho = rho)
    })), recursive = FALSE))
  list(headline = hl, perstudy = ps)
}

s2_cached <- c("r_objects/permanova_C3b_pervar.rds",
               "r_objects/permanova_E1_one_per_indiv.rds",
               "r_objects/permanova_G_perstudy.rds")
if (all(file.exists(s2_cached))) {
  s2_c3b <- readRDS(s2_cached[1])
  s2_e1  <- readRDS(s2_cached[2]); s2_e1 <- s2_e1[grepl("^E1 C3b", s2_e1$model), ]
  s2_hl  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(S2_VARS, function(v) {
    a <- s2_c3b[s2_c3b$term == v, ][1, ]; b <- s2_e1[s2_e1$term == v, ][1, ]
    data.frame(term = v, n_all = a$n, R2_all = a$R2, p_all = a$p,
               n_one = b$n, R2_one = b$R2, p_one = b$p)
  }))
  s2_ps <- readRDS(s2_cached[3])
} else {
  s2_obj <- s2_fit()
  s2_hl  <- s2_obj$headline
  s2_ps  <- s2_obj$perstudy
  saveRDS(s2_hl, "r_objects/tables_S2_headline.rds")
  saveRDS(s2_ps, "r_objects/tables_S3_perstudy.rds")
}
s2_ps$p_adj <- ave(s2_ps$p, s2_ps$variable, FUN = function(p) p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
table_S2 <- data.frame(
  Variable              = s2_hl$term,
  N_all                 = s2_hl$n_all,
  R2_all                = round(s2_hl$R2_all, 4),
  P_all                 = signif(s2_hl$p_all, 2),
  N_one_per_individual  = s2_hl$n_one,
  R2_one_per_individual = round(s2_hl$R2_one, 4),
  P_one_per_individual  = signif(s2_hl$p_one, 2))
write.csv(table_S2, file.path("tables", "Table_S2_permanova.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

table_S3 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(S2_VARS, function(v) {
  d <- s2_ps[s2_ps$variable == v, ]
  data.frame(Variable = v, Studies = nrow(d),
             `Significant (BH P < 0.05)` = sum(d$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
             `Fraction agreeing` = round(max(mean(d$direction_rho > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                                             mean(d$direction_rho < 0, na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(table_S3, file.path("tables", "Table_S3_perstudy.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(table_S2, row.names = FALSE)
print(table_S3, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Process Bioassay Data

```{r process_bioassay_data, include=FALSE}
bioassay_data <- bioassay_data %>%
  mutate(zoi = zoi / 10) %>%
  mutate(inhibition = case_when(
    zoi == 0           ~ 0,
    zoi > 0 & zoi < 1  ~ 1,
    zoi >= 1 & zoi < 2 ~ 2,
    zoi >= 2           ~ 3
  ))

inhibition_counts <- bioassay_data %>%
  count(inhibition) %>%
  mutate(
    inhibition = factor(inhibition, levels = 0:3),
    fraction   = n / sum(n),
    ymax       = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin       = dplyr::lag(ymax, default = 0)
  )

total_assays    <- sum(inhibition_counts$n)
formatted_total <- comma(total_assays)

target_hits <- bioassay_data %>%
  mutate(inhibition = as.integer(inhibition)) %>%
  count(target, inhibition, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  mutate(
    n_total = sum(n),
    prop    = n / n_total * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(inhibition %in% 1:3) %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  mutate(hit_rate = sum(prop)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "Achromobacter xylosoxidans" ~ "*A. xylosoxidans*",
      target == "Burkholderia cenocepacia"   ~ "*B. cenocepacia*",
      target == "Burkholderia cepacia"       ~ "*B. cepacia*",
      target == "Neisseria meningitidis"     ~ "*N. meningitidis*",
      target == "Pseudomonas aeruginosa"     ~ "*P. aeruginosa*",
      target == "Rothia mucilaginosa"        ~ "*R. mucilaginosa*",
      target == "Staphylococcus aureus"      ~ "*S. aureus*",
      target == "Streptococcus oralis"       ~ "*S. oralis*",
      TRUE ~ target
    ),
    target     = forcats::fct_reorder(target, hit_rate, .desc = TRUE),
    inhibition = factor(inhibition, levels = c(1, 2, 3))
  )

isolate_inhibition <- left_join(bioassay_data, cf_isolates, by = "isolate")

isolate_inhibition <- isolate_inhibition %>%
  dplyr::select(isolate, hid, genus, target, inhibition) %>%
  mutate(genus = case_when(
    genus == "Staphylococcus"     ~ "*Staphylococcus*",
    genus == "Pseudomonas"        ~ "*Pseudomonas*",
    genus == "Bacillus"           ~ "*Bacillus*",
    genus == "Enterococcus"       ~ "*Enterococcus*",
    genus == "Lacticaseibacillus" ~ "*Lacticaseibacillus*",
    genus == "Klebsiella"         ~ "*Klebsiella*",
    genus == "Streptococcus"      ~ "*Streptococcus*",
    genus == "Escherichia"        ~ "*Escherichia*",
    genus == "Stenotrophomonas"   ~ "*Stenotrophomonas*",
    genus == "Microbacterium"     ~ "*Microbacterium*",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  filter(genus != "Other") %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  mutate(N_isolates = n_distinct(isolate)) %>%
  group_by(genus, inhibition) %>%
  summarize(
    count = n(),
    N_isolates = dplyr::first(N_isolates),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  mutate(
    inhibition = factor(as.character(inhibition), levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3")),
    percent    = count / sum(count),
    inhib_pct  = sum(percent[inhibition %in% c("1", "2", "3")], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(genus = forcats::fct_reorder(genus, inhib_pct, .desc = TRUE))

total_inhibition_per_isolate <- bioassay_data %>%
  group_by(isolate) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(target) == 8) %>%
  summarize(total_inhibition_score = sum(inhibition, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

total_inhibition_per_isolate <- left_join(total_inhibition_per_isolate, cf_isolates, by = "isolate")

total_inhibition_per_isolate <- total_inhibition_per_isolate %>%
  dplyr::select(isolate, hid, genus, total_inhibition_score) %>%
  mutate(genus = case_when(
    genus == "Staphylococcus"     ~ "*Staphylococcus*",
    genus == "Pseudomonas"        ~ "*Pseudomonas*",
    genus == "Bacillus"           ~ "*Bacillus*",
    genus == "Enterococcus"       ~ "*Enterococcus*",
    genus == "Lacticaseibacillus" ~ "*Lacticaseibacillus*",
    genus == "Klebsiella"         ~ "*Klebsiella*",
    genus == "Streptococcus"      ~ "*Streptococcus*",
    genus == "Escherichia"        ~ "*Escherichia*",
    genus == "Stenotrophomonas"   ~ "*Stenotrophomonas*",
    genus == "Microbacterium"     ~ "*Microbacterium*",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  filter(genus != "Other") %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  mutate(
    .sd_g = sd(total_inhibition_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .mn_g = mean(total_inhibition_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_within_genus = ifelse(.sd_g > 0,
                            (total_inhibition_score - .mn_g) / .sd_g,
                            0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-.sd_g, -.mn_g) %>%
  mutate(
    .sd_all = sd(total_inhibition_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .mn_all = mean(total_inhibition_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_overall = ifelse(.sd_all > 0,
                       (total_inhibition_score - .mn_all) / .sd_all,
                       0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.sd_all, -.mn_all)

median_order <- total_inhibition_per_isolate %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarize(med = median(z_overall, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(med)) %>%
  pull(genus) %>%
  as.character()

total_inhibition_per_isolate <- total_inhibition_per_isolate %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(as.character(genus), levels = median_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genus))
```

### Stats: Chi-square by Target

```{r stats_chi_target, include=FALSE}
target_hits_stats <- bioassay_data %>%
  mutate(inhibition = as.integer(inhibition)) %>%
  count(target, inhibition, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(inhibition = factor(as.character(inhibition), levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3")))

chi_target_tab  <- xtabs(n ~ target + inhibition, data = target_hits_stats)
chi_target_test <- chisq.test(chi_target_tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 100000)

chi_target_df <- (nrow(chi_target_tab) - 1) * (ncol(chi_target_tab) - 1)
sprintf("Target test: X^2 = %.1f, df = %d, p < %.1e",
        unname(chi_target_test$statistic), chi_target_df, chi_target_test$p.value)
```

### Stats: Chi-square by Genus

```{r stats_chi_genus, include=FALSE}
isolate_inhibition_for_chi <- isolate_inhibition %>%
  mutate(inhibition = factor(as.character(inhibition), levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3")))

chi_genus_tab  <- xtabs(count ~ genus + inhibition, data = isolate_inhibition_for_chi)
chi_genus_test <- chisq.test(chi_genus_tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 100000)

chi_genus_df <- (nrow(chi_genus_tab) - 1) * (ncol(chi_genus_tab) - 1)
sprintf("Genus test: X^2 = %.1f, df = %d, p < %.1e",
        unname(chi_genus_test$statistic), chi_genus_df, chi_genus_test$p.value)
```

```{r stats_fligner_global, include=FALSE}
var_fligner_global
```

### Stats: Fligner-Killeen Pairwise + Letters (Holm)

```{r stats_fligner_pairwise, include=FALSE}
fligner_gs    <- levels(factor(total_inhibition_per_isolate$genus))
fligner_pairs <- combn(fligner_gs, 2, simplify = FALSE)

fligner_pairs_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fligner_pairs, function(g) {
  d <- subset(total_inhibition_per_isolate, genus %in% g)
  data.frame(g1 = g[1], g2 = g[2],
             p  = fligner.test(z_overall ~ genus, data = d)$p.value)
}))

fligner_pairs_df$padj <- p.adjust(fligner_pairs_df$p, method = "BH")

# named vector "g1-g2" for multcompView
fligner_padj_vec <- fligner_pairs_df$padj
names(fligner_padj_vec) <- paste(fligner_pairs_df$g1, fligner_pairs_df$g2, sep = "-")

fligner_letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters(fligner_padj_vec, threshold = 0.05)
fligner_letters_df <- data.frame(
  genus   = names(fligner_letters$Letters),
  letters = unname(fligner_letters$Letters),
  row.names = NULL
)
```

```{r stats_kw_global, include=FALSE}
kw_global_test <- kruskal.test(z_overall ~ genus, data = total_inhibition_per_isolate)
kw_global_test
```

### Stats: Pairwise Wilcoxon (Holm) + Letters

```{r stats_kw_pairwise_letters, include=FALSE}
kw_pw_test <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
  x      = total_inhibition_per_isolate$z_overall,
  g      = total_inhibition_per_isolate$genus,
  p.adjust.method = "BH",
  exact  = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

# convert the triangular adjusted p-value matrix to a named vector "g1-g2"
kw_pmat <- kw_pw_test$p.value
kw_idx  <- which(!is.na(kw_pmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
kw_pvec <- kw_pmat[kw_idx]
names(kw_pvec) <- paste(rownames(kw_pmat)[kw_idx[, "row"]],
                        colnames(kw_pmat)[kw_idx[, "col"]],
                        sep = "-")

kw_letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters(kw_pvec, threshold = 0.05)

genus_order_kw <- levels(total_inhibition_per_isolate$genus)
raw_kw   <- kw_letters$Letters[genus_order_kw]
chars_in_order <- unique(unlist(strsplit(raw_kw, "")))
lmap_kw  <- setNames(letters[seq_along(chars_in_order)], chars_in_order)
kw_letters_df <- data.frame(
  genus   = genus_order_kw,
  letters = sapply(raw_kw, function(l)
    paste(sort(lmap_kw[strsplit(l, "")[[1]]]), collapse = "")),
  row.names = NULL
)
```

## Intrasubject Pseudomonas Strain Variability

```{r pseudomonas_intrasubject_variability, include=FALSE}
pseudomonas_variable_hids <- total_inhibition_per_isolate %>%
  filter(grepl("Pseudomonas", genus, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(hid) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  summarize(z_spread = max(z_within_genus) - min(z_within_genus), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(z_spread >= 2) %>%
  pull(hid)

pseudomonas_variable_isolates <- total_inhibition_per_isolate %>%
  filter(grepl("Pseudomonas", genus, ignore.case = TRUE),
         hid %in% pseudomonas_variable_hids) %>%
  group_by(hid) %>%
  summarize(
    z_spread = max(z_within_genus) - min(z_within_genus),
    isolates = paste(paste0(isolate, " (", round(z_within_genus, 2), ")")[order(-z_within_genus)], collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(z_spread))
```

## LC-MS/MS

```{r fig7_S7B_data, include=FALSE}
lcms_p_cutoff <- 0.01     
lcms_n_perm   <- 9999     
lcms_n_boot   <- 1000     

lcms_host_pal <- c(HID07 = "#7570B3", HID08 = "#fdb462ff", HID16 = "#bebada",
                   HID17 = "#b3de69", HID23 = "#f0e04d")
lcms_inh_pal  <- c(Yes = "#6c8197", No = "#c0cad5")
lcms_val_col  <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4575B4", "#FFFFFF", "#D73027"))

lcms_norm_iso <- function(x) {
  s <- sub("^X[0-9.]+_", "", x); s <- sub("_[A-Z]$", "", s)
  ifelse(grepl("^NB", s), sprintf("NB%04d", as.integer(sub("^NB0*", "", s))), s)
}
lcms_first <- which(colnames(lcms_diff) == "postHoc") + 1
lcms_scols <- colnames(lcms_diff)[lcms_first:ncol(lcms_diff)]
lcms_ciso  <- lcms_norm_iso(lcms_scols)
lcms_icols <- lcms_scols[lcms_ciso != "BHI"]
lcms_iso   <- lcms_ciso[lcms_ciso != "BHI"]

# significant features (raw intensities) + isolate means
lcms_sig     <- which(lcms_diff$pvalue <= lcms_p_cutoff)
lcms_raw     <- as.matrix(lcms_diff[lcms_sig, lcms_icols])
rownames(lcms_raw) <- lcms_diff$name[lcms_sig]; colnames(lcms_raw) <- lcms_icols
lcms_iso_raw <- t(apply(lcms_raw, 1, function(v) tapply(v, lcms_iso, mean)))

# BHI blank-subtracted copy of the same features
lcms_bcols <- lcms_scols[lcms_ciso == "BHI"]
lcms_bmean <- rowMeans(as.matrix(lcms_diff[lcms_sig, lcms_bcols]))
lcms_sub   <- pmax(lcms_raw - lcms_bmean, 0)

lcms_samp_meta <- tibble(sample = lcms_icols, isolate = lcms_iso) %>%
  left_join(lcms_meta, by = "isolate") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(lcms_samp_meta) <- lcms_samp_meta$sample
lcms_iso_meta <- lcms_meta %>%
  filter(isolate %in% colnames(lcms_iso_raw)) %>%
  arrange(match(isolate, colnames(lcms_iso_raw))) %>% as.data.frame()
lcms_host_pal <- lcms_host_pal[names(lcms_host_pal) %in% lcms_iso_meta$host]

# per-feature z-scored log2 isolate-mean matrix
lcms_zscore <- function(m) { z <- t(scale(t(m))); z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0; z }
lcms_matz   <- lcms_zscore(log2(lcms_iso_raw + 1))
```

```{r ggtheme, include=FALSE}
fix_panel_size <- function(p, w = unit(3.129, "in"), h = unit(3.129, "in")) {
  g <- if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) ggplotGrob(p) else p
  idx <- which(g$layout$name == "panel")
  for (i in idx) {
    g$widths[g$layout$l[i]]  <- w
    g$heights[g$layout$t[i]] <- h
  }
  g
}
```

### Figure 1A

```{r fig_1A, include=FALSE}
N_BOOT_1A <- 2000

ra_wide_1A <- per_sample_ra %>%
  filter(taxon %in% metacommunity_genera) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, taxon, ra) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = taxon, values_from = ra, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(sample)
ra_mat_1A <- as.matrix(dplyr::select(ra_wide_1A, -sample))
n_samp_1A <- nrow(ra_mat_1A)

prev_fn_1A  <- function(M) colSums(M >= 1)  / nrow(M) * 100
dom_fn_1A   <- function(M) colSums(M >  50) / nrow(M) * 100
conditional_dominance_fn_1A <- function(M) {
  np <- colSums(M >= 1); nd <- colSums(M > 50)
  ifelse(np == 0, NA_real_, nd / np * 100)
}

boot_arr_1A <- array(
  NA_real_,
  dim = c(N_BOOT_1A, ncol(ra_mat_1A), 3),
  dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(ra_mat_1A),
                  c("prev_1_pct", "dominant_pct", "conditional_dominance"))
)
for (b in seq_len(N_BOOT_1A)) {
  Mb <- ra_mat_1A[sample.int(n_samp_1A, n_samp_1A, replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  boot_arr_1A[b, , "prev_1_pct"]       <- prev_fn_1A(Mb)
  boot_arr_1A[b, , "dominant_pct"]     <- dom_fn_1A(Mb)
  boot_arr_1A[b, , "conditional_dominance"] <- conditional_dominance_fn_1A(Mb)
}
ci_lo_1A <- apply(boot_arr_1A, c(2, 3), quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
ci_hi_1A <- apply(boot_arr_1A, c(2, 3), quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

ci_long_1A <- bind_rows(
  tibble(genus = rownames(ci_lo_1A), metric = "prev_1_pct",
         lo = ci_lo_1A[, "prev_1_pct"], hi = ci_hi_1A[, "prev_1_pct"]),
  tibble(genus = rownames(ci_lo_1A), metric = "dominant_pct",
         lo = ci_lo_1A[, "dominant_pct"], hi = ci_hi_1A[, "dominant_pct"]),
  tibble(genus = rownames(ci_lo_1A), metric = "conditional_dominance",
         lo = ci_lo_1A[, "conditional_dominance"], hi = ci_hi_1A[, "conditional_dominance"])
)

  "Dominance (>50% Relative Abundance)"      = "#6c8197",
  "Conditional Dominance (Dominance/Prevalence)"        = "#94a8bf"
)

                    conditional_dominance = "Conditional Dominance (Dominance/Prevalence)"),
```

```{r fig_1B, include=FALSE}
set.seed(8675309)

alpha_cont <- alpha_adj
alpha_cont$FEV1 <- as.numeric(alpha_cont$FEV1)
alpha_cont$Age  <- as.numeric(alpha_cont$Age)
alpha_cont <- alpha_cont[!is.na(alpha_cont$FEV1) &
                         !is.na(alpha_cont$shannon) &
                         !is.na(alpha_cont$Age), ]

alpha_cont$FEV1_adj <- residuals(
  lm(FEV1 ~ Age + BioProject + Sample_Type + Region, data = alpha_cont)) +
  mean(alpha_cont$FEV1)

alpha_cont$age_bin <- cut(alpha_cont$Age, breaks = c(-Inf, 12, 18, 40, Inf),
                          right = FALSE, labels = c("0\u201311", "12\u201317", "18\u201339", "40+"))
age_bins_1b <- levels(alpha_cont$age_bin)[table(alpha_cont$age_bin) > 0]
age_n_1b    <- table(alpha_cont$age_bin)[age_bins_1b]
age_lab_1b  <- setNames(paste0(age_bins_1b, " (N=", age_n_1b, ")"), age_bins_1b)
alpha_cont$age_group <- factor(age_lab_1b[as.character(alpha_cont$age_bin)],
                               levels = age_lab_1b[age_bins_1b])
cols_1b <- setNames(unname(age_base_cols[age_bins_1b]), age_lab_1b[age_bins_1b])

n_boot_1b <- 100; n_1b <- nrow(alpha_cont)
boot_lines_1b <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_boot_1b), function(b) {
  bi  <- sample.int(n_1b, n_1b, replace = TRUE)
  fit <- lm(alpha_cont$FEV1_adj[bi] ~ alpha_cont$shannon[bi])
  data.frame(x = range(alpha_cont$shannon),
             y = coef(fit)[1] + coef(fit)[2] * range(alpha_cont$shannon), boot = b)
}))

panel_1b <- ggplot(alpha_cont, aes(x = shannon, y = FEV1_adj)) +
  geom_line(data = boot_lines_1b, aes(x = x, y = y, group = boot),
            color = "lightblue", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(aes(color = age_group), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#4575B4", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_1b, name = "Age") +
  labs(x = expression(Diversity~"("*italic(H)*"'"*")"),
       y = expression(Lung~Function~"("*FEV[1]~pp[Adj]*")")) +
  fig1_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                              override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2)))
```

```{r fig_1, include=FALSE}
fig2_panel_size <- grid::unit(3.2, "in")

pad_to_height <- function(g, target_h_in) {
  cur_h <- sum(grid::convertHeight(g$heights, "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  if (cur_h < target_h_in) {
    g <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, grid::unit(target_h_in - cur_h, "in"))
  }
  g
}

leg_1b <- cowplot::get_legend(panel_1b)
leg_1c <- cowplot::get_legend(panel_1c)

fix_panel_size_grob <- function(g, w, h) {
  panels <- g$layout[g$layout$name == "panel", ]
  l_idx <- panels$l[1]; r_idx <- panels$r[1]
  t_idx <- panels$t[1]; b_idx <- panels$b[1]
  g$widths[l_idx:r_idx]  <- w
  g$heights[t_idx:b_idx] <- h
  g
}
```

### Figure 2C

```{r fig_2C, include=FALSE}
C2_DEPTH  <- 1000    
C2_DRAWS  <- 2000   
C2_BREAKS <- c(1, 10, 20, 35, 50, 75)
C2_LABS   <- c(">0-1", "1-10", "10-20", "20-35", "35-50", "50-75", ">75")
C2_POS    <- c(0.5, 5.5, 15, 27.5, 42.5, 62.5, 87.5)   # bin midpoints, linear scale

c2_oro   <- setdiff(colnames(genus_matrix_filt), cf_pathogens)
c2_ra    <- 100 * genus_matrix_filt / rowSums(genus_matrix_filt)
c2_pRA   <- rowSums(c2_ra[, cf_pathogens, drop = FALSE])
c2_pRds  <- rowSums(genus_matrix_filt[, cf_pathogens, drop = FALSE])
c2_pRA_all <- c2_pRA           # kept for the lung-function series, which is not
c2_pRds_all <- c2_pRds         # depth-filtered
c2_keep  <- rowSums(genus_matrix_filt[, c2_oro, drop = FALSE]) >= C2_DEPTH
c2_O     <- genus_matrix_filt[c2_keep, c2_oro, drop = FALSE]
c2_P     <- c2_O / rowSums(c2_O)
c2_pRA   <- c2_pRA[c2_keep]; c2_pRds <- c2_pRds[c2_keep]

c2_bin <- ifelse(c2_pRds == 0, "0",
           as.character(cut(c2_pRA, c(-Inf, C2_BREAKS, Inf), labels = C2_LABS)))
c2_bin <- factor(c2_bin, levels = c("0", C2_LABS))
c2_idx <- lapply(levels(c2_bin), function(l) which(c2_bin == l))

c2_pairs <- combn(c2_oro, 2); c2_i1 <- c2_pairs[1, ]; c2_i2 <- c2_pairs[2, ]
c2_bvec  <- function(M) {
  L <- log10(M + 1); C <- cov(L); C[cbind(c2_i1, c2_i2)] / diag(C)[c2_i2]
}

c2_rar <- function(Pm, D) {
  n <- nrow(Pm); K <- ncol(Pm); X <- matrix(0L, n, K)
  rem <- rep(D, n); remp <- rep(1, n)
  for (j in seq_len(K - 1)) {
    q <- pmin(pmax(Pm[, j] / remp, 0), 1); q[!is.finite(q)] <- 0
    x <- rbinom(n, rem, q); X[, j] <- x; rem <- rem - x; remp <- remp - Pm[, j]
  }
  X[, K] <- rem; colnames(X) <- colnames(Pm); X
}

dir.create("r_objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
if (file.exists("r_objects/fig2C_boot.rds")) {
  c2_mb <- readRDS("r_objects/fig2C_boot.rds")
} else {
  set.seed(97)
  c2_mb <- matrix(NA_real_, C2_DRAWS, length(levels(c2_bin)))
  for (b in seq_len(C2_DRAWS)) for (j in seq_along(c2_idx)) {
    s <- sample(c2_idx[[j]], length(c2_idx[[j]]), replace = TRUE)
    c2_mb[b, j] <- mean(c2_bvec(c2_rar(c2_P[s, , drop = FALSE], C2_DEPTH)))
  }
  colnames(c2_mb) <- levels(c2_bin)
  saveRDS(c2_mb, "r_objects/fig2C_boot.rds")
}

c2_rel <- c2_mb / c2_mb[, 1]
c2_pl  <- 2:ncol(c2_mb)
c2_bp  <- function(v) { p1 <- mean(v <= 0); max(2 * min(p1, 1 - p1), 1 / C2_DRAWS) }
c2_cmb <- combn(length(c2_pl), 2)
c2_Q   <- p.adjust(vapply(seq_len(ncol(c2_cmb)), function(k)
  c2_bp(c2_mb[, c2_pl][, c2_cmb[1, k]] - c2_mb[, c2_pl][, c2_cmb[2, k]]),
  numeric(1)), "BH")

c2_M <- matrix(1, length(c2_pl), length(c2_pl), dimnames = list(C2_LABS, C2_LABS))
for (k in seq_len(ncol(c2_cmb)))
  c2_M[c2_cmb[1, k], c2_cmb[2, k]] <- c2_M[c2_cmb[2, k], c2_cmb[1, k]] <- c2_Q[k]

c2_adj <- c2_M > 0.05; diag(c2_adj) <- TRUE
c2_mn  <- colMeans(c2_mb[, c2_pl]); c2_cl <- list()
for (sz in length(c2_pl):1) for (cb in asplit(combn(length(c2_pl), sz), 2)) {
  v <- as.integer(cb)
  if (all(c2_adj[v, v]) && !any(vapply(c2_cl, function(c0) all(v %in% c0), logical(1))))
    c2_cl[[length(c2_cl) + 1]] <- v
}
c2_cl  <- c2_cl[order(vapply(c2_cl, function(v) -max(c2_mn[v]), numeric(1)))]
c2_ltr <- setNames(rep("", length(c2_pl)), C2_LABS)
for (i in seq_along(c2_cl)) for (j in c2_cl[[i]])
  c2_ltr[C2_LABS[j]] <- paste0(c2_ltr[C2_LABS[j]], letters[i])

fig2c_df <- data.frame(
  stratum = C2_LABS, pos = C2_POS,
  n       = as.integer(table(c2_bin))[c2_pl],
  rel     = colMeans(c2_rel[, c2_pl]),
  lo      = apply(c2_rel[, c2_pl], 2, quantile, 0.025),
  hi      = apply(c2_rel[, c2_pl], 2, quantile, 0.975),
  letter  = c2_ltr[C2_LABS], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

C2_FEV_CUT <- 80
c2_meta  <- cf_microbiome_metadata[match(rownames(genus_matrix_filt),
                                         cf_microbiome_metadata$Run), ]
c2_fev   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(c2_meta$FEV1))
c2_binF  <- ifelse(c2_pRds_all == 0, "0",
             as.character(cut(c2_pRA_all, c(-Inf, C2_BREAKS, Inf), labels = C2_LABS)))
c2_binF  <- factor(c2_binF, levels = c("0", C2_LABS))
c2_hi    <- !is.na(c2_fev) & c2_fev >= C2_FEV_CUT
c2_okF   <- !is.na(c2_fev) & c2_binF != "0"
c2_idxF  <- lapply(C2_LABS, function(l) which(c2_binF == l & c2_okF))

if (file.exists("r_objects/fig2C_lf_boot.rds")) {
  c2_fb <- readRDS("r_objects/fig2C_lf_boot.rds")
} else {
  set.seed(11)
  c2_fb <- matrix(NA_real_, C2_DRAWS, length(C2_LABS))
  for (b in seq_len(C2_DRAWS)) for (j in seq_along(c2_idxF))
    c2_fb[b, j] <- 100 * mean(c2_hi[sample(c2_idxF[[j]],
                                           length(c2_idxF[[j]]), replace = TRUE)])
  saveRDS(c2_fb, "r_objects/fig2C_lf_boot.rds")
}
colnames(c2_fb) <- C2_LABS

c2_QF <- p.adjust(vapply(seq_len(ncol(c2_cmb)), function(k)
  c2_bp(c2_fb[, c2_cmb[1, k]] - c2_fb[, c2_cmb[2, k]]), numeric(1)), "BH")
c2_MF <- matrix(1, length(C2_LABS), length(C2_LABS),
                dimnames = list(C2_LABS, C2_LABS))
for (k in seq_len(ncol(c2_cmb)))
  c2_MF[c2_cmb[1, k], c2_cmb[2, k]] <- c2_MF[c2_cmb[2, k], c2_cmb[1, k]] <- c2_QF[k]
c2_adjF <- c2_MF > 0.05; diag(c2_adjF) <- TRUE
c2_mnF  <- colMeans(c2_fb); c2_clF <- list()
for (sz in length(C2_LABS):1) for (cb in asplit(combn(length(C2_LABS), sz), 2)) {
  v <- as.integer(cb)
  if (all(c2_adjF[v, v]) && !any(vapply(c2_clF, function(c0) all(v %in% c0), logical(1))))
    c2_clF[[length(c2_clF) + 1]] <- v
}
c2_clF  <- c2_clF[order(vapply(c2_clF, function(v) -max(c2_mnF[v]), numeric(1)))]
c2_ltrF <- setNames(rep("", length(C2_LABS)), C2_LABS)
for (i in seq_along(c2_clF)) for (j in c2_clF[[i]])
  c2_ltrF[C2_LABS[j]] <- paste0(c2_ltrF[C2_LABS[j]], letters[i])

fig2c_lf <- data.frame(stratum = C2_LABS, pos = C2_POS,
  n = lengths(c2_idxF), pct = c2_mnF,
  lo = apply(c2_fb, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  hi = apply(c2_fb, 2, quantile, 0.975),
  letter = c2_ltrF[C2_LABS], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

c2_track <- vapply(seq_len(C2_DRAWS), function(b)
  cor(c2_rel[b, c2_pl], c2_fb[b, ], method = "spearman"), numeric(1))
c2_track_p <- max(2 * min(mean(c2_track <= 0), mean(c2_track >= 0)), 1 / C2_DRAWS)

C2_Y  <- c(0.12, 1.41); C2_F <- c(0, 85)
c2_f2y <- function(v) C2_Y[1] + (v - C2_F[1]) * diff(C2_Y) / diff(C2_F)
C2_OFF <- 1.6      
c2_a <- transform(fig2c_df, x = pos - C2_OFF)
c2_b <- transform(fig2c_lf,
  x = pos + C2_OFF, y = c2_f2y(pct), ylo = c2_f2y(lo), yhi = c2_f2y(hi))

panel_2c <- ggplot() +
  geom_errorbar(data = c2_a, aes(x, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 1.8,
                linewidth = 0.55, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = c2_a, aes(x, rel), size = 3.0, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = c2_a, aes(x, hi + 0.05, label = letter),
            size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = c2_b, aes(x, ymin = ylo, ymax = yhi), width = 1.8,
                linewidth = 0.55, color = "#4575B4") +
  geom_point(data = c2_b, aes(x, y), size = 3.0, color = "#4575B4") +
  geom_text(data = c2_b, aes(x, yhi + 0.05, label = letter),
            size = 3.5, color = "#4575B4") +
  scale_x_continuous("Pathogen Relative Abundance (%)",
                     breaks = C2_POS, labels = C2_LABS) +
  scale_y_continuous("Relative Mean Oropharyngeal Covariation",
    breaks = seq(0.25, 1.25, 0.25),
    labels = sprintf("%.2f", seq(0.25, 1.25, 0.25)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ C2_F[1] + (. - C2_Y[1]) * diff(C2_F) / diff(C2_Y),
      name = expression("High Lung Function ("*FEV[1]~pp>=80*", %)"),
      breaks = seq(0, 80, 20))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.5, 90), ylim = C2_Y) +
  labs(tag = "C") +
  gg_theme +
  theme(axis.line    = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 10, color = "#4575B4"),
        axis.title.y.right= element_text(size = 11, color = "#4575B4"),
        plot.tag     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

sprintf("Figure 2C: covariation reference n = %d, lung function n = %d",
        length(c2_idx[[1]]), sum(lengths(c2_idxF)))
sprintf("series track: Spearman = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f to %.2f), P = %.4f",
        cor(fig2c_df$rel, fig2c_lf$pct, method = "spearman"),
        quantile(c2_track, 0.025), quantile(c2_track, 0.975), c2_track_p)
print(fig2c_df, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
print(fig2c_lf, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
```

```{r fig_2, include=FALSE}
pad_to_height <- function(g, target_h_in) {
  cur_h <- sum(grid::convertHeight(g$heights, "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  if (cur_h < target_h_in) {
    g <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, grid::unit(target_h_in - cur_h, "in"))
  }
  g
}
fig2_hmax   <- max(vapply(fig2_panels, function(g)
  sum(grid::convertHeight(g$heights, "in", valueOnly = TRUE)), numeric(1)))
fig2_panels <- lapply(fig2_panels, pad_to_height, target_h_in = fig2_hmax)
```

```{r fig_4_xstreak, include=FALSE}
SY_MIN_ASSAYS <- 10

sy_genera <- unique(c(pairwise_results$genus1, pairwise_results$genus2))

sy_assays <- bioassay_data %>%
  left_join(cf_isolates %>% dplyr::select(isolate, genus), by = "isolate") %>%
  dplyr::rename(producer = genus) %>%
  mutate(target_genus = sub(" .*$", "", target)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(producer), producer %in% sy_genera,
         target_genus %in% sy_genera, producer != target_genus)

sy_dir <- sy_assays %>%
  group_by(producer, target_genus) %>%
  summarize(assays = n(), pct_inh = 100 * mean(inhibition >= 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(assays >= SY_MIN_ASSAYS)

sy_key <- function(a, b) paste(pmin(a, b), pmax(a, b), sep = "|")
sy_pairs <- sy_dir %>%
  mutate(pair = sy_key(producer, target_genus)) %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  slice_max(pct_inh, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(bx = pairwise_results$bx[match(pair,
           sy_key(pairwise_results$genus1, pairwise_results$genus2))]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bx))

SY_BAR <- "⟞"
sy_lv  <- c(paste("Pathogen",      SY_BAR, "Pathogen"),
            paste("Pathogen",      SY_BAR, "Oropharyngeal"),
            paste("Oropharyngeal", SY_BAR, "Pathogen"),
            paste("Oropharyngeal", SY_BAR, "Oropharyngeal"))

sy_tp <- sy_pairs$target_genus %in% cf_pathogens

  guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL, nrow = 2, order = 1,

SY_SYMFONT <- "Segoe UI Symbol"
SY_GAP     <- 4.5   # pt of space on each side of the inhibition bar
SY_RAISE   <- 0.6   # pt lift so the bar centres on the cap height, not the baseline
sy_metrics <- function(s, fam, fs, K = 100) {
  m <- systemfonts::shape_string(s, family = fam, size = fs * K)$metrics
  list(adv = m$width / K, lb = m$left_bearing / K, rb = m$right_bearing / K)
}
sy_mixed <- function(g0) {
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(g0$label, SY_BAR, fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  fs  <- if (is.null(g0$gp$fontsize)) 9.2 else g0$gp$fontsize
  fam <- if (is.null(g0$gp$fontfamily) || !nzchar(g0$gp$fontfamily)) "Arial"
         else g0$gp$fontfamily
  m1 <- sy_metrics(parts[1], fam, fs)
  mb <- sy_metrics(SY_BAR, SY_SYMFONT, fs)
  m2 <- sy_metrics(parts[2], fam, fs)
  # place on ink edges, not advance widths, so the gaps either side of the bar
  # are equal to the eye
  xb  <- (m1$adv - m1$rb) + SY_GAP - mb$lb
  x2  <- (xb + mb$adv - mb$rb) + SY_GAP - m2$lb
  off <- c(0, xb, x2)
  txt <- c(parts[1], SY_BAR, parts[2])
  gps <- lapply(c("", SY_SYMFONT, ""), function(f) {
    g <- g0$gp; if (nzchar(f)) g$fontfamily <- f; g
  })
  gt <- grid::gTree(children = do.call(grid::gList, mapply(function(s, g, o, r)
    grid::textGrob(s, x = g0$x + grid::unit(o, "pt"),
                   y = g0$y + grid::unit(r, "pt"),
                   hjust = 0, vjust = g0$vjust, gp = g),
    txt, gps, off, c(0, SY_RAISE, 0), SIMPLIFY = FALSE)))
  attr(gt, "sy_w") <- x2 + m2$adv
  gt
}
sy_fix <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "gtable")) {
    for (k in seq_along(x$grobs)) {
      x$grobs[[k]] <- sy_fix(x$grobs[[k]])
      w  <- attr(x$grobs[[k]], "sy_w")
      cl <- x$layout$l[k]
      if (!is.null(w)) {
        x$widths[cl] <- grid::unit.pmax(x$widths[cl], grid::unit(w + 5.5, "pt"))
      }
    }
    x
  }
  else if (inherits(x, "gTree")) {
    if (!is.null(x$children)) {
      x$children <- do.call(grid::gList, lapply(x$children, sy_fix))
      w <- vapply(x$children, function(ch) {
        a <- attr(ch, "sy_w"); if (is.null(a)) NA_real_ else a
      }, numeric(1))
      if (any(!is.na(w))) attr(x, "sy_w") <- max(w, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    x
  } else if (inherits(x, "text") && length(x$label) == 1 &&
             grepl(SY_BAR, x$label, fixed = TRUE)) sy_mixed(x) else x
}
```

```{r fig_7, include=FALSE}
lcms_node_pos <- function(hc) {
  m <- hc$merge; ord <- hc$order; cx <- numeric(nrow(m))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(m))) {
    a <- m[i, 1]; b <- m[i, 2]
    xa <- if (a < 0) which(ord == -a) - 0.5 else cx[a]
    xb <- if (b < 0) which(ord == -b) - 0.5 else cx[b]
    cx[i] <- (xa + xb) / 2
  }
  data.frame(x = cx, y = hc$height)
}
```

### Figure 8

```{r fig_8, include=FALSE}
local({
  PD  <- file.path("derivedData", "genome_comparison", "plotdata")
  FIG <- "figures"
  dir.create(FIG, showWarnings = FALSE)

  meta   <- read.csv(file.path(PD, "meta.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  legend <- read.csv(file.path(PD, "bgc_legend.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # palette follows this document (RdYlBu / Okabe-Ito)
  VAR_CLASSES <- c("Frameshift", "Missense", "Silent", "Intergenic")
  VAR_COL <- c("Frameshift" = "#D73027", "Missense" = "#E69F00",
               "Silent" = "#999999", "Intergenic" = "#CC79A7")

  # radii (unit circle)
  R_BGC_OUT <- 1.00; R_BGC_IN <- 0.90
  R_MUT_OUT <- 0.86; R_MUT_IN <- 0.72
  R_NUM     <- 1.13
  R_MB      <- 1.21

  xy <- function(r, f) list(x = r * sin(2 * pi * f), y = r * cos(2 * pi * f))
  tf <- function(f, o, off) ((o * f) + off) %% 1       # reorient panel B onto A

  arc_poly <- function(f1, f2, ri, ro, col) {
    if (f2 < f1) f2 <- f2 + 1
    ff  <- seq(f1, f2, length.out = max(2, round((f2 - f1) * 400)))
    ang <- 2 * pi * ff
    polygon(c(ro * sin(ang), rev(ri * sin(ang))),
            c(ro * cos(ang), rev(ri * cos(ang))), col = col, border = NA)
  }

  spread_ang <- function(ang, mingap) {                # de-overlap numeric labels
    ord <- order(ang); a <- ang[ord]; n <- length(a)
    for (it in 1:400) {
      moved <- FALSE
      for (i in 1:n) {
        j <- if (i == n) 1 else i + 1
        gap <- (a[j] - a[i]) %% (2 * pi)
        if (gap < mingap) {
          d <- (mingap - gap) / 2
          a[i] <- (a[i] - d) %% (2 * pi); a[j] <- (a[j] + d) %% (2 * pi); moved <- TRUE
        }
      }
      if (!moved) break
    }
    out <- numeric(n); out[ord] <- a; out
  }

  draw_panel <- function(donor, panel) {
    m   <- meta[meta$donor == donor, ]
    o <- m$orient; off <- m$offset
    bgc <- read.csv(file.path(PD, sprintf("bgc_%s.csv", donor)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    mut <- read.csv(file.path(PD, sprintf("mut_%s.csv", donor)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    mut <- mut[mut$noninh_specific == 1, , drop = FALSE]          # only variants in the non-inhibitory genome
    L   <- m$length

    par(mar = c(0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 0.4))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(-1.32, 1.32), ylim = c(-1.30, 1.34), asp = 1,
         axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")

    arc_poly(0, 1, R_BGC_IN, R_BGC_OUT, col = "#ECEAE2")           # backbone

    for (mb in 0:floor(L / 1e6)) {                                 # Mb ticks
      f <- mb * 1e6 / L
      p1 <- xy(R_BGC_OUT, f); p2 <- xy(R_BGC_OUT + 0.035, f)
      segments(p1$x, p1$y, p2$x, p2$y, col = "#9A988F", lwd = 0.9)
      pl <- xy(R_MB, f); text(pl$x, pl$y, mb, col = "#6b6a64", cex = 0.95)
    }

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(bgc))) {                                # BGC arcs
      a <- tf(bgc$f_start[i], o, off); b <- tf(bgc$f_end[i], o, off)
      if (o == -1) { tmp <- a; a <- b; b <- tmp }
      arc_poly(a, b, R_BGC_IN, R_BGC_OUT, col = bgc$color[i])
    }

    ang0 <- 2 * pi * tf(bgc$f_mid, o, off)
    angL <- spread_ang(ang0, mingap = 0.115)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(bgc))) {
      a0 <- xy(R_BGC_OUT, ang0[i] / (2 * pi)); aL <- xy(R_NUM, angL[i] / (2 * pi))
      segments(a0$x, a0$y, aL$x, aL$y, col = "#B4B2A9", lwd = 0.7)
      text(aL$x, aL$y, bgc$num[i], cex = 1.15, col = "#2C2C2A")
    }

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(mut))) {
      f <- tf(mut$f[i], o, off)
      p1 <- xy(R_MUT_IN, f); p2 <- xy(R_MUT_OUT, f)
      segments(p1$x, p1$y, p2$x, p2$y, col = VAR_COL[[mut$class[i]]], lwd = 2.0)
      if (mut$inbgc[i] == 1) {                                    # BGC-associated
        ps <- xy(R_MUT_IN - 0.035, f)
        text(ps$x, ps$y, "*", col = "#2C2C2A", cex = 1.8, font = 2)
      }
    }

    text(0,  0.15, m$reference, cex = 2.0, font = 2)              
    text(0,  0.01, donor, cex = 1.15, col = "#5F5E5A")
    text(0, -0.12, sprintf("%.2f Mb", L / 1e6), cex = 1.1, col = "#5F5E5A")
    text(0, -0.25, sprintf("%d variants", nrow(mut)), cex = 1.1, col = "#5F5E5A")
    text(-1.30, 1.30, panel, cex = 2.0, font = 2, adj = 0)
  }

  draw_mut_key <- function() {
    par(mar = c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
    cx <- 1.1; segw <- 0.014; gap <- 0.03               
    x <- 0.01
    for (j in seq_along(VAR_CLASSES)) {                 
      segments(x, 0.5, x + segw, 0.5, col = VAR_COL[[VAR_CLASSES[j]]], lwd = 5)
      text(x + segw + 0.006, 0.5, VAR_CLASSES[j], adj = 0, cex = cx, col = "#000000")
      x <- x + segw + 0.006 + strwidth(VAR_CLASSES[j], cex = cx) + gap
    }
    text(x, 0.5, "*", adj = 0, cex = cx * 1.3, font = 2, col = "#2C2C2A")  # BGC glyph
    text(x + strwidth("* ", cex = cx), 0.5, "BGC-Associated", adj = 0, cex = cx, col = "#000000")
  }

  draw_bgc_legend <- function() {                      
    par(mar = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.1, 0.5))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
    n <- nrow(legend); ncols <- 9
    text(0.0, 0.93, "BGCs", adj = 0, cex = 1.2, font = 2, col = "#000000")
    colw <- 1 / ncols; swx <- 0.008; swy <- 0.06; y_row <- c(0.58, 0.20)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      r  <- if (i <= ncols) 1 else 2
      cc <- if (i <= ncols) i else i - ncols
      x <- (cc - 1) * colw + 0.004; y <- y_row[r]
      rect(x, y - swy, x + swx, y + swy, col = legend$color[i], border = "#00000030", lwd = 0.4)
      text(x + swx + 0.006, y, sprintf("%d. %s", legend$num[i], legend$label[i]),
           adj = 0, cex = 0.82, col = "#000000")
    }
  }

  render <- function(open_dev, ext) {
    open_dev()
    layout(matrix(c(1, 2,
                    3, 3,
                    4, 4), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
           widths = c(1, 1), heights = c(1, 0.12, 0.22))
    draw_panel("HID07", "A")
    draw_panel("HID08", "B")
    draw_mut_key()               
    draw_bgc_legend()            
    dev.off()
  }

  render(function() cairo_pdf(file.path(FIG, "figure_8.pdf"), width = 15, height = 8.7,
                              pointsize = 12), "pdf")
})
```

### Tables S6 and S7

```{r tables_S6_S7, include=FALSE}
lcms_gc_tab <- file.path("derivedData", "genome_comparison", "tables")
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

build_variant_table <- function(donor, outfile) {
  v <- read.delim(file.path(lcms_gc_tab, paste0(donor, "_differences.tsv")),
                  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")
  b <- read.delim(file.path(lcms_gc_tab, paste0(donor, "_variants_in_BGCs.tsv")),
                  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  v$TYPE <- c(snp = "SNP", ins = "Insertion", del = "Deletion")[v$TYPE]
  v$BGC_associated <- ifelse(as.integer(v$POS) %in% b$position, "Yes", "No")
  v$BGC <- b$BGC[match(as.integer(v$POS), b$position)]; v$BGC[is.na(v$BGC)] <- ""
  ren <- c(CHROM = "Contig", POS = "Position", TYPE = "Type", REF = "Ref", ALT = "Alt",
           EFFECT = "Effect", LOCUS_TAG = "Locus_tag", GENE = "Gene", PRODUCT = "Product")
  hit <- names(v) %in% names(ren); names(v)[hit] <- ren[names(v)[hit]]
  v[is.na(v)] <- ""                                  
  write.csv(v, outfile, row.names = FALSE)
  v
}
table_S6 <- build_variant_table("HID07", file.path("tables", "Table_S6.csv"))  # HID07
table_S7 <- build_variant_table("HID08", file.path("tables", "Table_S7.csv"))  # HID08
```

```{r fig_S1A, include=FALSE}
                              colnames(pw_pathogen_mat)[pw_pathogen_idx[, "col"]],
```

### Figure S3

```{r fig_S3_genus_age, include=FALSE}
GENUS_THRESH <- 1     

ga_build <- function(require_fev1) {
  M <- genus_matrix_filt
  M <- M[rowSums(M) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  mt <- cf_microbiome_metadata[match(rownames(M), cf_microbiome_metadata$Run), ]
  mt$FEV1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mt$FEV1))
  mt$Age  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mt$Age))
  ok <- !is.na(mt$Age) & !is.na(mt$Sample_Type) & mt$Sample_Type != ""
  if (require_fev1) ok <- ok & !is.na(mt$FEV1)
  M <- M[ok, , drop = FALSE]; mt <- mt[ok, ]
  ind <- run_indiv[rownames(M)]
  keep <- !is.na(ind)
  M <- M[keep, , drop = FALSE]; mt <- mt[keep, ]; ind <- ind[keep]
  pool <- rowsum(M, group = ind)
  modal <- function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  meta <- data.frame(
    indiv = rownames(pool),
    Age   = tapply(mt$Age,         ind, mean)[rownames(pool)],
    FEV1  = tapply(mt$FEV1,        ind, mean)[rownames(pool)],
    BP    = tapply(mt$BioProject,  ind, modal)[rownames(pool)],
    ST    = tapply(mt$Sample_Type, ind, modal)[rownames(pool)],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  list(ra = sweep(pool, 1, rowSums(pool), "/") * 100, meta = meta)
}
ga_age <- ga_build(FALSE)
ga_lf  <- ga_build(TRUE)

ga_age$meta$agr <- factor(ifelse(ga_age$meta$Age >= 18, "18+", "0–17"),
                          levels = c("0–17", "18+"))
ga_lf$meta$fev10 <- -ga_lf$meta$FEV1 / 10   # per 10-point DECREASE

ga_fit <- function(obj, term, adj_age) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(obj$ra), function(g) {
    d <- data.frame(pres = as.integer(obj$ra[, g] >= GENUS_THRESH),
                    x = obj$meta[[term]], BP = factor(obj$meta$BP),
                    ST = factor(obj$meta$ST), Age = obj$meta$Age)
    d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]
    f <- if (adj_age) pres ~ x + Age + BP + ST else pres ~ x + BP + ST
    s <- tryCatch(summary(glm(f, data = d, family = binomial))$coefficients,
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    rn <- if (is.null(s)) NA else grep("^x", rownames(s), value = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.null(s) || is.na(rn)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(genus = g, OR = exp(s[rn, 1]),
               lo = exp(s[rn, 1] - 1.96 * s[rn, 2]),
               hi = exp(s[rn, 1] + 1.96 * s[rn, 2]),
               p = s[rn, 4], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
ga_A <- ga_fit(ga_age, "agr",   FALSE)   
ga_B <- ga_fit(ga_lf,  "fev10", TRUE)    
ga_A$q <- p.adjust(ga_A$p, "BH")
ga_B$q <- p.adjust(ga_B$p, "BH")

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

ga_gen  <- colnames(ga_age$ra)
ga_ord  <- c(fig1_pathogen_order[fig1_pathogen_order %in% ga_gen],
             sort(ga_gen[!ga_gen %in% cf_pathogens]))
ga_gold <- "#E69F00"
ga_labs <- setNames(ifelse(rev(ga_ord) %in% cf_pathogens,
  paste0("<span style='color:", ga_gold, "'><i>", rev(ga_ord), "</i></span>"),
  paste0("<i>", rev(ga_ord), "</i>")), rev(ga_ord))

ga_prep <- function(d, mult) {
  d$sig  <- d$q < 0.05
  d$path <- d$genus %in% cf_pathogens
  qv <- ifelse(d$q < 0.001, formatC(d$q, format = "e", digits = 1),
        ifelse(d$q < 0.01,  sprintf("%.3f", d$q), sprintf("%.2f", d$q)))
  d$txt <- paste0("*Q* = ", qv)
  d$qx  <- ifelse(d$OR < 1, d$lo / mult, d$hi * mult)
  d$qh  <- ifelse(d$OR < 1, 1, 0)
  d$genus <- factor(d$genus, levels = rev(ga_ord))
  d
}
ga_A <- ga_prep(ga_A, 1.07); ga_B <- ga_prep(ga_B, 1.015)

ga_panel <- function(d, brks, labl, lims, xlab, ylabs) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(OR, genus, color = path)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), width = 0, linewidth = 0.6,
                  orientation = "y") +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.2, fill = "white", stroke = 0.9) +
    ggtext::geom_richtext(aes(x = qx, label = txt, hjust = qh), size = 2.8,
                          color = "black", fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                          label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = ga_gold, `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 21), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = brks, labels = labl, limits = lims,
                  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL) +
    gg_theme +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
          axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11, color = "black"),
          axis.line    = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
          plot.tag     = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))
  if (ylabs) p + scale_y_discrete(labels = ga_labs) +
                 theme(axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 9.5))
  else       p + scale_y_discrete(labels = rep("", length(ga_ord))) +
                 theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
                       axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25))
}
```
