```{r fig_S4_analysis, include=FALSE}
MIN_REGION_N <- 100

region_vec <- cf_microbiome_metadata$Region[
  match(rownames(genus_matrix_filt), cf_microbiome_metadata$Run)]

overall_pairs <- pairwise_results[, c("genus1", "genus2", "bx", "pval", "significant")]
names(overall_pairs)[names(overall_pairs) == "significant"] <- "sig"
overall_pairs$r <- mapply(function(a, b) cor(log_abund[, a], log_abund[, b]),
                          overall_pairs$genus1, overall_pairs$genus2)
overall_pairs$direction <- ifelse(overall_pairs$bx > 0, "Positive", "Negative")

region_levels <- sort(unique(region_vec))

region_pair_list   <- list()
region_concordance <- list()
for (rg in region_levels) {
  idx <- which(region_vec == rg)
  rr  <- fit_region_pairs(log10(genus_matrix_filt[idx, , drop = FALSE] + 1))
  rr$sig <- rr$pval < bonf_thresh

  m <- merge(overall_pairs[, c("genus1", "genus2", "bx", "r", "sig", "direction")],
             rr[, c("genus1", "genus2", "bx", "r", "sig")],
             by = c("genus1", "genus2"), suffixes = c("_ov", "_rg"))
  m$region <- rg
  m$n      <- length(idx)
  region_pair_list[[rg]] <- m

  est   <- !is.na(m$bx_rg)                       # pair estimable in this region
  ovsig <- m$sig_ov & est                        # associations "predicted" by the pooled model
  region_concordance[[rg]] <- data.frame(
    region           = rg,
    n                = length(idx),
    n_estimable      = sum(est),
    n_sig_region     = sum(m$sig_rg & est, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_overall_sig    = sum(ovsig),
    sign_concordance = 100 * mean(sign(m$bx_rg[ovsig]) == sign(m$bx_ov[ovsig])),
    spearman_bx      = cor(m$bx_ov[est], m$bx_rg[est], method = "spearman"),
    ccc_bx           = ccc(m$bx_ov[est], m$bx_rg[est]),
    pearson_std_r    = cor(m$r_ov[est],  m$r_rg[est],  method = "pearson"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
region_pair_df     <- do.call(rbind, region_pair_list)
region_concordance <- do.call(rbind, region_concordance)
region_concordance$underpowered <- region_concordance$n < MIN_REGION_N

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
print(region_concordance, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fig_S4, include=FALSE}
region_lab <- setNames(

assoc_cols <- c("Positive" = "#4575B4", "Negative" = "#D73027",
                "NS" = "gray75")

AXIS_LIM <- range(c(region_pair_df$bx_ov, region_pair_df$bx_rg), na.rm = TRUE)
AXIS_LIM <- AXIS_LIM + c(-1, 1) * 0.06 * diff(AXIS_LIM)

pair_plot_df <- region_pair_df
pair_plot_df$region_f <- factor(region_lab[pair_plot_df$region],
                                levels = region_lab[region_levels])
pair_plot_df$pt_class <- factor(
  ifelse(!pair_plot_df$sig_ov, "NS", pair_plot_df$direction),
  levels = c("Positive", "Negative", "NS"))
pair_plot_df <- pair_plot_df[order(pair_plot_df$pt_class, decreasing = TRUE), ]

facet_ann <- region_concordance
facet_ann$region_f <- factor(region_lab[facet_ann$region],
                             levels = region_lab[region_levels])
facet_ann$txt <- sprintf("Signs %.0f%%  ·  CCC=%.2f",
                         facet_ann$sign_concordance, facet_ann$ccc_bx)

panel_S4A <- ggplot(pair_plot_df, aes(x = bx_ov, y = bx_rg)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = pt_class), shape = 21, color = "black",
             stroke = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = facet_ann, aes(x = AXIS_LIM[1] + 0.03, y = AXIS_LIM[2] - 0.03,
            label = txt), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.7, color = "black",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ region_f, ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = assoc_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = AXIS_LIM, ylim = AXIS_LIM) +
  labs(x = "Overall Covariation Coefficient",
       y = "Per-Region Covariation Coefficient",
       tag = "A") +
  gg_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        strip.text   = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.tag     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

metric_levels <- c("Signs Matched", "Spearman Rank", "CCC")
metric_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(region = region_concordance$region, metric = metric_levels[1],
             value = region_concordance$sign_concordance / 100),
  data.frame(region = region_concordance$region, metric = metric_levels[2],
             value = region_concordance$spearman_bx),
  data.frame(region = region_concordance$region, metric = metric_levels[3],
             value = region_concordance$ccc_bx))
metric_df$metric <- factor(metric_df$metric, levels = metric_levels)

metric_df$region_f <- factor(metric_df$region, levels = rev(region_levels))

metric_cols  <- setNames(c("#4575B4", "#E69F00", "#333333"), metric_levels)
metric_shape <- setNames(c(16, 17, 15), metric_levels)

panel_S4B <- ggplot(metric_df, aes(x = value, y = region_f,

        legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.text        = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.tag           = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.25))

figure_S4 <- panel_S4A / panel_S4B +
```

```{r fig_S5, include=FALSE}
)
```

### Figure S7B

```{r fig_S7B, include=FALSE}
lcms_iso_sub <- t(apply(lcms_sub, 1, function(v) tapply(v, lcms_iso, mean)))
lcms_iprof   <- t(lcms_iso_sub); lcms_iprof <- lcms_iprof / rowSums(lcms_iprof)
dir.create("r_objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
if (file.exists("r_objects/lcms_permanova.rds")) {
  lcms_perm <- readRDS("r_objects/lcms_permanova.rds")
} else {
  set.seed(8675309)   # PERMANOVA permutation reproducibility
  lcms_perm <- adonis2(vegdist(lcms_iprof, "bray") ~ host + inhibition,
                       data = lcms_iso_meta, by = "margin", permutations = lcms_n_perm)
  saveRDS(lcms_perm, "r_objects/lcms_permanova.rds")
}
lcms_msres <- lcms_perm["Residual", "SumOfSqs"] / lcms_perm["Residual", "Df"]
lcms_sstot <- lcms_perm["Total", "SumOfSqs"]
lcms_omega2 <- function(tm) (lcms_perm[tm, "SumOfSqs"] - lcms_perm[tm, "Df"] * lcms_msres) /
  (lcms_sstot + lcms_msres)
lcms_eff <- data.frame(
  term   = c("host (donor)", "inhibition"),
  Df     = c(lcms_perm["host", "Df"], lcms_perm["inhibition", "Df"]),
  R2     = c(lcms_perm["host", "R2"], lcms_perm["inhibition", "R2"]),
  omega2 = c(lcms_omega2("host"), lcms_omega2("inhibition")),
  F      = c(lcms_perm["host", "F"], lcms_perm["inhibition", "F"]),
  p      = c(lcms_perm["host", "Pr(>F)"], lcms_perm["inhibition", "Pr(>F)"]))

# PCoA on per-injection profiles (Bray-Curtis, total-sum-scaled)
lcms_sprof <- t(lcms_sub); lcms_sprof <- lcms_sprof / rowSums(lcms_sprof)
lcms_pcoa  <- cmdscale(vegdist(lcms_sprof, "bray"), k = 2, eig = TRUE)
lcms_pvar  <- round(100 * lcms_pcoa$eig[1:2] / sum(lcms_pcoa$eig[lcms_pcoa$eig > 0]), 1)
lcms_mdsdf <- data.frame(lcms_samp_meta, PCoA1 = lcms_pcoa$points[, 1], PCoA2 = lcms_pcoa$points[, 2])

figure_S7B <- ggplot(lcms_mdsdf, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = host, group = host), type = "t", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_ellipse(data = subset(lcms_mdsdf, inhibition == "Yes"), color = lcms_inh_pal[["Yes"]],
               type = "t", linetype = "22", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_ellipse(data = subset(lcms_mdsdf, inhibition == "No"), color = lcms_inh_pal[["No"]],
               type = "t", linetype = "22", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = host, shape = inhibition), size = 3, stroke = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lcms_host_pal, name = "HID") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Yes = 16, No = 17), name = "Inhibition\nZ-Score ≥ 0") +
  labs(x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", lcms_pvar[1]), y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", lcms_pvar[2])) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) + fig1_theme
lcms_xy  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ggplot_build(figure_S7B)$data, function(d) d[c("x", "y")]))
lcms_lim <- range(lcms_xy, na.rm = TRUE); lcms_lim <- lcms_lim + c(-0.03, 0.03) * diff(lcms_lim)
figure_S7B <- figure_S7B + coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = lcms_lim, ylim = lcms_lim)

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/figure_S7B.pdf", figure_S7B, width = 6.5, height = 6.5, device = cairo_pdf)
```
